results.title: The Staircase
results.overview: After getting trapped in a mysterious staircase loop, A guy struggles to find his way home, only to discover that reality may not be what it seems.

results.title: The Floating Head of Frankenstein
results.overview: A mad scientist creates Frankenstein's Floating Head and Detective Rock must kick its ass. Shot in 2009, but unreleased until it was rediscovered in 2026.

results.title: Cutting Room Floor
results.overview: A desperate director-auteur turns serial killer after discovering the missing piece to her festival submission is the thrill of murder.

results.title: Autumns Decay
results.overview: Autumns Decay is a two-minute experimental film, shot on 16mm and incorporating double-frame exposures and single-frame stop-motion, that explores the fragility of life and the human body through fallen leaves coming apart.

results.title: Kirkasta Valoa
results.overview: A young criminal's dreams of a big deal go south as he goes on a surreal voyage through life and death.

results.title: Bravo
results.overview: Female rage is a peculiar thing. Heartbroken young painter Tina greets the dawn with a gunshot that seems to close the chapter on her failed relationship. Desperate to heal, in search of closure, she turns to an unconventional form of therapy - an intimate ritual that promises clarity and convinces her that she may finally be able to let go of her former lover.

results.title: My Best Human Impression
results.overview: Kody Holman (BODGE) is forced to reconcile with the unexpected and sudden loss of his father on a surreal and dark odyssey inspired by true events.

results.title: Reportage
results.overview: Reportage explores the relationship between death and storytelling through the lens of tabloid journalism in Mexico City. Following the journey of a single tragedy—from crime scene to printed headline—the film reveals how photographers, reporters, and press workers transform violence into narrative. Alongside them, a group of former inmates re-enact the crime, this time not as perpetrators, but as actors. In prison, they found a stage; through performance, a way to confront the violence they once committed.

results.title: Alex Jones: One Day in Aberfan
results.original_title: Alex Jones: Un Diwrnod Yn Aberfan
results.overview: Alex Jones marks the 60th anniversary of the mining disaster that claimed 144 lives, including 116 children

results.title: Alberto Angela tells Julius Caesar
results.overview: An evening event set against the prestigious backdrop of the Colosseum, exploring the life, achievements, loves, and legacy of Julius Caesar—one of history’s most significant figures. Before an audience of young people, and accompanied by the musical accompaniment of a live orchestra, Alberto Angela retraces Caesar’s extraordinary personal and political journey.

results.title: Golden Haze
results.overview: A top student, haunted by the pressure to succeed, finds her rigid equilibrium disrupted when she stumbles into unexpected journeys and quiet moments of self realisation through external circumstances. Until, for the first time, with naked, unguarded eyes, she peeks into the bright sunlight beyond the haze, and realises, she is freed from the soulless, uninvited notes, the world beyond that halo of light has always been waiting for her, to play out her own shining future.

results.title: I’m LATE?!?!
results.overview: A one minute short film where the main character finds themselves late for school.

results.title: Shadow
results.overview: On an ordinary school day, Yin skips class to look for Hei, who is resting at home, in order to confide in him about his own delusions.

results.title: Feel My Empty Soul
results.overview: Burnt-out social worker Chan, 40, meets Hei, 16, searching a carpark for a non-existing exit to freedom. Reminded of his own lost ideals, Chan initially relates to the boy but ultimately shatters his dream due to professional pressure.

results.title: A Story She Told
results.overview: The return of an old love quietly fractures a filmmaker's celebratory night, as a private past begins to reveal itself in the story she chose to tell.
